title: TRUE + 1 is 2: TRUE is 1 in arithmetic

source.quote: You can add TRUE + 1 and get the result 2 , because DAX implicitly converts TRUE to the number 1 , and does the operation 1+1
Boolean values are converted into numbers (0 for FALSE and 1 for TRUE) when they are involved in an addition

notes: The int64 type follows the page's wording, that the operation done is 1+1, an addition of two integers.
